I found 9 items worth using. Some sources disagree, and the Diwali-week dates are the most important ones to confirm before you post.

**Things that are new**

1. **Meta's ads assistant can now build campaigns by chat (testing).** Meta announced this at Advertising Week on 6 Oct. The assistant in Ads Manager can create campaigns, change targeting and budgets, and send scheduled reports. Static-to-video in Advantage+ is live for everyone, and a "Customer Lifecycle" setting removes existing buyers from acquisition campaigns. **Why you should care:** if you're a 1 to 5 person team, the free video tool and the buyer exclusion help you this week, so you don't need to make a video for every ad. The assistant is still a test. Fits the SCALE / ROAST topics. [Common Thread](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/metas-new-ai-agent-can-now-run-your-ads-what-the-advertising-week-2026-update-means-for-ecommerce-brands) · [PYMNTS](https://www.pymnts.com/news/artificial-intelligence/2026/meta-debuts-ai-tools-help-advertisers-find-customers/)
2. **Meta Ads MCP server.** Outside AI tools can now upload creative, preview ads and draft campaigns. Nothing goes live until a person approves it. **Why you should care:** tools like Claude can prepare your ads for you, and you still sign off. That fits a "4-agent team" follow-up (TEAM). [Inside AI News](https://insideai.news/news/ai-in-business/meta-ai-advertising-tools/13743/)
3. **Shopify opened its catalogue to outside AI shopping agents (13 Oct).** Through "Shop MCP", agents can search more than 1 billion listings and check out with Shop Pay. The buyer still approves every purchase. **Why you should care:** if a shopper's AI agent reads your product data, missing sizes, materials or delivery times mean it can't recommend you. Good STORE / DESC angle. **Catch:** a report from 8 Oct said Shopify blocked agents from completing checkout on merchant stores, and nobody has squared the two reports yet. Shop Pay is also mostly a non-India feature. [Ecommerce Paradise](https://ecommerceparadise.com/shopify-catalog-personal-ai-agents/) · [MLQ](https://mlq.ai/news/shopify-lets-shoppers-connect-more-ai-agents-to-its-catalog-and-shop-pay/)
4. **Shopify Canvas: edit your store by chatting with Sidekick (1 Oct, just before the 14-day window).** You see the changes live, without a developer or theme code. **Why you should care:** fixes you find in an AUDIT can now be made in minutes by the founder. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/01/shopify-debuts-canvas-a-way-to-build-online-stores-by-chatting-with-ai/)
5. **Instagram: clickable links in posts and Reels, plus grid reordering.** Instagram for Business promoted this on 13 Oct. **Why you should care:** you can link to a product page right from the Reel. **Catch:** links need a paid Meta One plan (Advanced tier and up, reportedly $14.99 to $499 a month). Separately, accounts that show unlabelled AI-generated people may get less reach, which matters for AI model shots. Mostly third-party coverage, not confirmed by Instagram itself. [SocialBee](https://socialbee.com/blog/instagram-updates/)
6. **ChatGPT shopping added virtual try-on and saved Favorites (1 Oct, also just outside the window).** Shoppers can upload a selfie to try on clothes. **Why you should care:** fashion D2C brands should check their products show up when someone asks ChatGPT for options. Reports also say ChatGPT's in-chat checkout was shut down in March 2026. [b2the7](https://www.b2the7.com/news-blog/chatgpt-news-october-2026-small-business-marketing)

**Dates coming up**

7. **The Diwali window is almost here.** Most sources give Dhanteras on 6 Nov, Diwali on Sun 8 Nov and Bhai Dooj on Wed 11 Nov. Govardhan Puja is listed as 9 Nov or 10 Nov. Amazon Great Indian Festival and Myntra BFF started 8 Oct, and Flipkart BBD opened to everyone on 9 Oct. **Why you should care:** that leaves about 3 weeks to plan a Dhanteras-to-Bhai-Dooj gifting push. Marketplace discounts are already setting what shoppers expect to pay. This is the right moment for the SALE planner. Check the dates on drikpanchang.com before posting. [Shubh Panchang](https://shubhpanchang.com/festivals/bhai-dooj) · [Goodreturns](https://www.goodreturns.in/news/when-is-diwali-in-2026-check-diwali-dhanteras-govardhan-pooja-bhai-dooj-date-other-info-1479316.html) · [FoneArena](https://www.fonearena.com/blog/492788/amazon-great-indian-festival-2026-date.html) · [Indian Retailer](https://www.indianretailer.com/article/retail-business/retail-trends/festive-sale-2026-flipkart-amazon-myntra-meesho-and-ajio-sale)

**Problems people are discussing**

8. **Festive COD returns (RTO).** Unicommerce data says about 58% of festive-quarter COD orders came back, against under 15% for prepaid. RTO peaked around 39% in Nov 2025. Brands brought it to about 21% with three fixes: a prepaid incentive, choosing the courier by pin code, and checking the address before dispatch. **Why you should care:** this is the biggest profit leak in Diwali week, and it fits the RTO confirm-order WhatsApp script exactly. **Catch:** these are vendor reports, so if you quote them, say where they came from. [First Resort](https://www.firstresort.in/blogs/research/fashion-ecommerce-returns-rto-india-2026) · [Unicommerce](https://unicommerce.com/india-d2c-report-2026-april/) · [HillTeck](https://www.hillteck.com/blog/rto-trends-2026-indian-d2c.html)

**One gap**

9. **WhatsApp Business: nothing new in the last 14 days.** The latest is Business AI in the WhatsApp Business app for Indian small businesses (May 2026). It answers questions and captures leads, and you can take over any chat. UPI payments inside the AI chat were announced but I couldn't confirm they've launched. **Why you should care:** you can use it for a free "set up your WhatsApp AI before Diwali" post. Just don't call it new. [Meta Newsroom](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/05/introducing-business-ai-on-whatsapp-for-small-businesses-in-india/)

**For next week's Sell more + Ads test:** Diwali + RTO (RTO or SALE) and Meta static-to-video (UGC or SCALE) are the most useful for the target audience right now. They also fit the week's plan of mixing Sell more with Ads and Operations.
